w10_P4_000101: The figure a materials lab wants, in kJ, is 3 times the per-cycle energy tally of a test rig. The per-cycle tally is the energy of motion of a 9000 gram slider, expressed in kJ, plus 21 kJ of heater energy, plus a further 6 kJ of pump energy. The slider's speed in m/s is the largest whole number that divides both 163 and 87 exactly. What figure, in kJ, does the lab report?
w10_P4_000110: A luggage-conveyor test cart of mass 108000 grams runs on a level bed. Its acceleration in m/s^2 is 9 times the larger of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 8x + 7 = 0. The force that produces that acceleration is shared: a helper spring contributes 28 N of it and the motor provides the rest, which the plant expresses in kN. Three such carts run side by side under identical conditions. What is the total motor force on the 3 carts, in kN?
w10_P4_000112: A test drone of mass 7 kg flies along a straight corridor, and its position in metres after t seconds is s(t) = 5t^3 - 1t^2. At t = 2 s a controller records the drone's speed and its energy of motion at that instant. The corridor houses 8 identical drones flying identically, and the facility runs 5 identical corridors. A monitoring circuit adds a constant 21 J to the combined total for its own stored energy. What total energy, in J, does the monitoring circuit report?
w10_P4_000115: A battery-powered luggage tug of mass 47 kg is tested on a straight lane 30 m long. Its test speed in m/s equals the area under the curve y = 1x^2 + 3x between x = 0 and x = 2. For each run the logger takes the tug's energy of motion at that speed, in kJ, and subtracts the 3 kJ drawn from the battery to reach it, recording the difference as the run's energy balance (negative means a deficit). The test consists of 6 identical runs. What is the total energy balance over the 6 runs, in kJ?
w10_P4_000116: The value a rig technician wants, in N, is the total load on a winch mount: the cable pull, plus 28 N of sheave friction, plus 20 N of guide drag, plus 27 N from a tensioning spring. The cable pull is the force required to accelerate a 157 kg carriage along a level rail 40 m long. The carriage's acceleration in m/s^2 equals the area under the curve y = 2x^2 + 0x between x = 1 and x = 3. What total load, in N, does the technician record?
w10_P4_000121: A lab bench holds two encoder discs with 398 and 144 slots, and the bench controller takes the largest whole number that divides both slot counts exactly, then multiplies it by 4 to set the launch speed, in m/s, of a 3 kg test puck. The puck's energy of motion at launch is logged in kJ. The logger adds 6 kJ for the energy held in the launch capacitor and then 11 kJ for the bench heater's contribution. What final figure, in kJ, does the logger show?
w10_P4_000122: An airport baggage tractor tows a cart of mass 177 kg across an apron 60 m wide. The cart's acceleration in m/s^2 is the smaller of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 11x + 30 = 0. The hitch must transmit the force that produces that acceleration plus 17 N of rolling drag, and the tractor's gauge reads that hitch force in kN. A train of 8 identical carts, each on its own hitch under identical conditions, is towed at once. What total hitch force, in kN, does the gauge report?
w10_P4_000126: The figure a shipyard wants, in kN, is the grand total drive load across 6 identical docks, each dock running 2 identical conveyor lines, each line carrying 10 identical crates, every crate receiving the same force. Each crate has a mass of 75 kg and slides on a frictionless line. The acceleration given to each crate, in m/s^2, is the smaller of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 15x + 56 = 0. What grand total drive load, in kN, does the shipyard report?
w10_P4_000140: A go-kart of mass 31 kg is timed on a test track, and its speed in m/s is set to 2 times the sum of 7 and 4. At that speed a data logger records the kart's energy of motion. It then adds 25 J for energy stored in the kart's flywheel, subtracts 25 J lost as heat in the bearings, adds 8 J from a boost spring, and finally subtracts 23 J absorbed by the tyres. What final energy figure, in J, does the logger record?
w10_P4_000144: The number a safety officer needs, in J, is the total impact energy on a barrier plus 14 J stored in the barrier's pads. The impact energy is delivered by 5 identical waves of 10 identical carts each, every cart hitting the barrier with the same energy of motion. Each cart has a mass of 42 kg and a track width of 0.9 m. The carts' speed in m/s is the largest whole number that divides both 50 and 278 exactly. What number, in J, does the safety officer record?
w10_P4_000146: The figure a workshop wants, in kJ (negative meaning a net loss), is the energy balance of a test: the gross energy captured, expressed in kJ, minus 6 kJ consumed by the test motor. The gross energy captured is 8 identical sled impacts plus 27 J released by a latch spring, where each impact deposits the sled's full energy of motion. The sled has a mass of 26000 grams and rides a track 5 m long. Its speed in m/s is the larger of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 4x + 3 = 0. What energy balance, in kJ, does the workshop record?
w10_P4_000161: A rail-mounted camera dolly's position along a straight track, in metres, is s(t) = 4t^3 - 2t^2 with t in seconds. A technician takes the dolly's acceleration at t = 3 s, adds 5, then subtracts 25, and uses the result as the launch speed, in m/s, of a 54000 gram test sled on a nearby lab bench that is 2.4 m long. What is the sled's energy of motion at that launch speed, in kJ?
w10_P4_000163: The figure a stadium engineer wants, in kJ, is the total energy delivered to a crash barrier plus 11 kJ already stored in the barrier's dampers. The delivered energy comes from 3 identical test sessions, each session's energy (expressed in kJ) being 4 identical impacts of a sled, every impact depositing the sled's full energy of motion. The sled has a mass of 53 kg and a height of 1.1 m. Its impact speed in m/s is the sum of all the whole numbers from 1 to 10. What figure, in kJ, does the engineer record?
w10_P4_000165: The final reading a lab bench displays, in J, is a running tally: it starts from a test trolley's energy of motion, adds 27 J from a heater, subtracts 14 J lost to friction, subtracts a further 18 J vented by a fan, and finally adds 19 J from a charging coil. The trolley has a mass of 25000 grams. Its speed in m/s is the largest whole number that divides both 321 and 263 exactly. What final reading, in J, does the bench display?
w10_P4_000166: The number a robotics depot wants, in kJ, is the total energy of motion across 5 identical bays, each bay running 12 identical carts, every cart's energy of motion being recorded in kJ. Each cart has a mass of 51000 grams. Each cart moves at a speed in m/s equal to 2 times the sum of 2 and 12. What total, in kJ, does the depot report?
w10_P4_000171: A robot-vacuum test bench fires a 49000 gram sled along a rail 3.2 m long. The sled's speed in m/s is the smaller of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 14x + 48 = 0. The bench logs the sled's energy of motion in kJ, multiplies it by 12 for the 12 sleds in a batch, and subtracts 16 kJ consumed by the bench's own drive motor to give the batch balance (negative meaning a net loss). Four batches are run. What is the total balance over the 4 batches, in kJ?
w10_P4_000175: The figure a lift engineer must enter, in kN, is the total cable load: the pull needed to accelerate the car plus 16 N of guide-rail friction. The car has a mass of 109 kg. Its acceleration in m/s^2 is 19 more than the largest whole number that divides both 71 and 26 exactly. What total cable load, in kN, does the engineer enter?
w10_P4_000177: The quantity a launch-site engineer wants, in kN, is the total mount load from 11 identical launch pads, each pad carrying 2 identical rails, each rail's load being the thrust on its sled (expressed in kN) plus 13 kN of rail preload. Each sled has a mass of 182000 grams. Its acceleration in m/s^2 equals the area under the curve y = 2x^2 + 3x between x = 1 and x = 4, and the thrust is exactly what produces that acceleration. What total mount load, in kN, does the engineer report?
w10_P4_000180: A test buggy's position along a straight desert track, in metres, is s(t) = 4t^3 - 6t^2 with t in seconds. An engineer takes the buggy's acceleration at t = 3 s and uses that number as the speed, in m/s, of a 14 kg projectile fired from a launcher on the same range. The projectile's energy of motion at that speed is recorded in kJ. The launcher fires 10 identical projectiles per salvo, and the range fires 5 salvos. What total energy, in kJ, is recorded for the 5 salvos?
w10_P4_000182: A car-wash conveyor pushes a 120 kg dolly along a track 22 m long. The dolly's acceleration in m/s^2 is the larger of the two values x that satisfy x^2 - 11x + 24 = 0. The conveyor drives 12 such dollies at once, each with the force that produces that acceleration; a tension spring relieves 4 N of the combined push, and a brush drag adds 3 N to it. Two identical conveyors run side by side. What total push, in N, do the 2 conveyors deliver?
w10_P4_000183: A rocket-sled crew has 8 identical booster cartridges and counts every way of choosing 4 of them for one run; that count is used as the sled's acceleration in m/s^2. The sled has a mass of 138000 grams and its run lasts 4.5 s. The thrust needed for that acceleration, plus 20 N of rail friction, is the load on one rail clamp. There are 7 identical clamps sharing identical loads, and a counterweight relieves 29 N from their combined total. What is the combined clamp load, in kN?
w10_P4_000189: At a tram depot a test bogie of mass 199000 grams is accelerated along a straight siding. Its acceleration in m/s^2 is 3 times the area under the curve y = 3x^2 + 8x between x = 0 and x = 1. The traction motor supplies exactly the force needed for that acceleration, and the depot runs 11 identical bogies on 11 identical sidings at once. The combined motor force is expressed in kN, and a 5 kN static counterweight load is subtracted to give the net figure for the depot's report. What net figure, in kN, appears in the report?
w10_P4_000191: The figure a wind-tunnel operator wants, in kJ, is the net energy budget: the gross energy of a 2-run session, expressed in kJ, minus 27 kJ consumed by the tunnel fans. Each run's gross energy is the energy of motion of a 9000 gram test model plus 24 J from its release spring. The model's speed in m/s is 6 times the sum of 7 and 3. What net energy budget, in kJ, does the operator report?
w10_P4_000193: A bottling plant runs a shuttle of mass 39 kg along a rail 15 m long. The shuttle's speed in m/s is 12 times the largest whole number that divides both 361 and 356 exactly. Each shuttle carries a fixed energy of motion at that speed, and one line runs 8 identical shuttles at once. The plant reports the energy of motion of a line in kJ. There are 10 identical lines. What is the total energy of motion of all 10 lines, in kJ?
w10_P4_000196: A projectile of mass 24 kg is fired from a test mortar with a barrel 1.8 m long. Its muzzle speed in m/s equals the area under the curve y = 1x^2 + 8x between x = 2 and x = 4. The muzzle energy of motion is adjusted by subtracting 6 J lost to barrel friction and adding 20 J from the sabot spring, and the adjusted energy is recorded in kJ. There are 9 identical shots fired. What total adjusted energy, in kJ, is recorded for the 9 shots?
